verification.note: CAUTION: no official (White House) copy of the accord is stored. The stored sources are the American Presidency Project's copy of the accord (UC Santa Barbara; archive/_runs/2026-10-14-refresh-ids-ca-on-01-coe-01-int-15-us-ca/US-27/extra-199626f0e9/), which gives the title, subtitle, date of 29 September 2026, full text and signature block, and the statement of Reps. Obernolte and Trahan of 1 October 2026 on obernolte.house.gov, stored as a secondary source; both count as secondary, so the level stays C. The American Presidency Project page of the President's Truth Social posts of 29 September 2026 was also stored, but its text layer lists only links and image names, so the press reports that the accord was released there remain unconfirmed. No copy on whitehouse.gov was found by web search on 11 and 14 October 2026. The roundtable, EO 14434 link and the 'morally binding' remark in notes rest on press reports that are not stored.

record.notes: Signed on 29 Sep 2026 (a Tuesday), after a White House roundtable and alongside EO 14434, by President Trump and Sundar Pichai (Google), Dario Amodei (Anthropic), Mark Zuckerberg (Meta), Greg Brockman (OpenAI), Elon Musk (xAI) and Jensen Huang (Nvidia). President Trump called it 'morally binding'. It has no enforcement mechanism and no breach reporting, and each company chooses its own external auditor or evaluator; the accord says it may make sense to codify these steps into laws or regulations over time. The House sponsors of the FRONTIER Act welcomed it on 1 Oct 2026 and want it codified. It is the current administration's counterpart to the Biden-era voluntary commitments of July 2023.

judgment.status_reasoning: The accord (29 September 2026) is a voluntary commitment: 'Regardless of whether this is required of companies ... each of our companies are committed to doing this', and the companies 'will meet regularly'. The 1 October 2026 congressional statement treats it as signed and current. Nothing stored shows withdrawal or replacement. Status: Published (non-binding, current); legal_force Non-binding, since the text itself leaves codification into law for the future.
judgment.date_reasoning: The American Presidency Project copy dates the accord September 29, 2026; the congressional statement of Thursday 1 October 2026 says it was signed 'on Tuesday', i.e. 29 September 2026. They agree.
judgment.scope_reasoning: Government-brokered and published voluntary commitments by frontier AI developers; in scope (the existing record has no scope_note and is kept as is).
